title: Elasticsearch vs OpenSearch: Which One Actually Scales? ⚡
fb_caption:
Elasticsearch vs OpenSearch: Which Architecture Actually Scales in Production? ⚡

• Throughput: Analyzing raw indexing & query performance under load.
• Latency: Examining response times for critical search operations.
• Consistency: Understanding data replication & read/write guarantees.
• Failure Modes: Evaluating resilience and recovery mechanisms.
• Operational Overhead: Comparing management complexity & resource needs.

Recommendation: For mature, feature-rich ecosystems and enterprise support, Elasticsearch often leads. For greater flexibility, community-driven innovation, and avoiding potential licensing changes, OpenSearch presents a compelling alternative.
